mgmt_bio.text: Frank van Zanten, 59, has led Bunzl as chief executive since 2016, having joined the group through his family business, which Bunzl acquired in the mid-1990s, and having served as managing director of Continental Europe from 2005. His path reflects the decentralized model he now oversees, in which founders and owner-managers of acquired businesses stay on to lead their operating companies and the most successful rise to regional and group-level roles, making Bunzl an attractive home for sellers. Under his leadership, capital allocation balances reinvestment in IT systems, warehouse upgrades and vehicle routing and warehouse management systems with disciplined acquisitions, typically at 6-8x EBITA, and returns to shareholders, including 33 consecutive years of dividend growth at a 9% compound annual rate.
